snippet.title: THE LIFT - Console Announcement Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about THE LIFT: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3283240 

The Lift is an eerie, story-driven handyman simulator in which you renovate and explore a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. Set in a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet science fiction, The Lift puts a surreal twist on the handyman gameplay formula, tasking players with a wide range of jobs from vacuuming reality-distorting anomalies and collecting fuel from robotic bees, to reviving interdimensional satellite dishes and repairing sentient reactors.
During the Triple-I Initiative, developer Fantastic Signals and publisher tinyBuild have showcased a brand-new Gameplay Trailer, and revealed that The Lift will be coming to Steam, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S in 2027.


Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative 

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
